messages:
sasha: T-minus 45 for the EU midnight change window. Final murmur rollout readiness check — quick status please. Ping rollback owners and deploy-bot if anything is blocking.

sasha: TL;DR: canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%. Pin v3.4.2 -> v3.5 for this window.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: 2026-03-22T00:10:00Z. Route policy: latency-first. Pinned image: registry.redwood/v3.5@sha256:abc123. Canary weight=10%.

raj: On rollback if DB schema shows any oddness. I have the quick revert ready: `pg_restore --dbname=prod_snapshot --single-transaction` and a read-only gate.

amanda: Frontend checked, feature flag for new prompt UI is off by default. I will watch client errors and can toggle if needed. :eyes:

ops-oncall: Infra green. Autoscaler warm-up tested. Node pool spare=6 GPUs. Monitoring alerts set: latency>200ms, error-rate>1% -> auto rollback trigger.

amanda: Small callout — embeddings batch job could overlap with canary. I've scheduled the embeddings batch to finish by 23:45 UTC.

raj: Confirmed. If rollback, I will notify data-team and run DB failback script.

ops-oncall: Rollback playbook snippet attached below for quick copy:
```
# rollback to pinned v3.4.2
kubectl set image deployment/api api=registry.redwood/v3.4.2 -n production
kubectl rollout status deployment/api -n production
# restore DB snapshot if needed
pg_restore --dbname=prod_snapshot --single-transaction
```

tess: Release notes: https://confluence.redwood/relnotes/v3.5 (prod checklist at bottom). Please confirm changelog acknowledgements.

dan: Last-minute test: ran a smoke loop against canary endpoints for 15 mins, no 5xx, avg latency 85ms. :thumbsup:

amanda: Approvals: SE + Platform + Sec signed off on the change doc. Security flagged one arg-parsing minor that was patched this morning.

raj: Rollback owner contact: pager (raj-db), phone +1-555-0102. Ops fallback: fail-route to legacy cluster if traffic >90% errors.

sasha: Ok — if no blockers by T-minus 10 (00:00 UTC) we kick canary. Final checklist I want loud confirmation on:
- deploy-bot scheduled and pinned (yes)
- rollback owners + contacts (yes)
- embeddings batch finished (yes)
- monitoring alerts in place (yes)
- release notes posted (yes)

sasha: Please reply with a single word ack when ready. :rotating_light:

raj: ack

amanda: ack

dan: ack

tess: ack

ops-oncall: ack

sasha: Launching canary in 10. Will post status updates in this thread. Good luck all. :rocket:
